en.headline: Your blood pressure tablet
body: It helps your blood vessels relax.
Tell your doctor if your ankles swell.
en.passage: Amlodipine helps to relax your blood vessels so blood moves more easily.

ms.headline: Ubat tekanan darah anda
body: Ubat ini membantu saluran darah anda mengendur.
Beritahu doktor anda jika buku lali anda bengkak.
ms.passage: Amlodipine helps to relax your blood vessels so blood moves more easily.
